title: Gendered Mental Health Stigma in Masked Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the probability of masked language models filling masked tokens with female versus male subjects (pronouns, nouns, and names) in sentences describing mental health conditions, treatment-seeking behaviors, and specific stigma attributes.

Comparing gender disparities in masked token predictions between mental health-related prompts and general physical health-related prompts, as well as evaluating model associations with nine dimensions of mental health stigma (e.g., blame, anger, avoidance, pity) using prompts adapted from the Attribution Questionnaire (AQ-27).
